headline: FY2028 department budget, library director search, and six funding requests are on the agenda.
summary: Two policy drafts, on records retention and book sale donations, are up for discussion. Other items include a trustee resignation, two Friends of the Leach Library fundraisers, and two contracts.
items: Schedule of December 2 and January 6 meetings
Digital Display Birthday Fundraiser proposal from Friends of the Leach Library
Door Harp Raffle Fundraiser proposal from Friends of the Leach Library
ENE Systems of New Hampshire service agreement
NH BET Training: Managing in a Union Environment funding request
2027 Staff Summer Reading T-Shirts funding request
Acceptance of unanticipated funds from an anonymous donor under RSA 202-A:4-c: seven $5.00 Dunkin Donuts gift cards for staff appreciation
location: Meeting Room, Leach Library, 276 Mammoth Road, Londonderry NH
plain_text:
AGENDA 
Leach Library Board of Trustees 
Londonderry, New Hampshire 03053 
 
The regular meeting of the Leach Library Board of Trustees will be held on Wednesday, 
November 4, 2026, at 7:00 PM in the Meeting Room at Leach Library, 276 Mammoth 
Road, Londonderry NH. The meeting will be recorded for later viewing on the 
Londonderry NH Government Access YouTube Channel. 
 
The Leach Library's mission is to provide materials, information, and services for 
community residents of all ages to meet their personal, educational, and recreational 
needs.
